//: This repository's own configuration. It is also the worked example the documentation refers to: an artifact whose delivery boundary is not a deployment.

verification.//stage1: Everything that can be proven without leaving the working tree.
verification.//stage2: The boundary here is the plugin loader, the installer, and — since #49 — a real agent session. Whether the gopnik-setup skill's conversation actually happens is a property of an agent, and an agent CLI on this machine is how you find out. Three verdicts called that unreachable while `claude` was installed. Since #73 the same applies to the gate itself: two fixtures one line of product code apart, which must come back with opposite verdicts.
stage2: umask 077; GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/gopnik-stage2.XXXXXX) && mkdir -p "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/cfg" && test -z "$(ls -A "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/cfg")" && printf '%s\n' "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT" > .git/gopnik-stage2-root && git rev-parse HEAD > "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/expected-sha"
GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT=$(cat .git/gopnik-stage2-root) && CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/cfg" claude plugin marketplace add madduck-tech/gopnik
GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT=$(cat .git/gopnik-stage2-root) && CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/cfg" claude plugin marketplace update madduck-tech
GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT=$(cat .git/gopnik-stage2-root) && CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/cfg" claude plugin details gopnik | grep -Eq 'Skills[^0-9]*3([^0-9]|$)'

GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT=$(cat .git/gopnik-stage2-root) && git clone --branch main https://github.com/madduck-tech/gopnik "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/src" && test "$(git -C "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/src" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(cat "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/expected-sha")" && mkdir -p "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/proj" && printf 'keep\n' > "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/proj/owned.txt" && sha256sum "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/proj/owned.txt" > "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/owned.sha" && cd "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/proj" && sh "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/src/install.sh" --claude && sha256sum -c "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/owned.sha" && test -f .claude/skills/gopnik/SKILL.md && test -f .claude/skills/gopnik-critic/SKILL.md && test -f .claude/skills/gopnik-setup/SKILL.md

GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT=$(cat .git/gopnik-stage2-root) && for GOPNIK_FIXTURE in "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT"/src/tests/fixtures/*/repo; do test -x "$GOPNIK_FIXTURE/check.sh" || exit 1; done && test -x "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/src/tests/fixtures/stage1-gap/repo/ui-tests/run.sh" && test -x "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/src/tests/fixtures/gate-ui-covered/repo/ui-tests/run.sh" && test -x "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT/src/tests/fixtures/stage1-stale/repo/ui-tests/run.sh"

GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT=$(cat .git/gopnik-stage2-root) && case "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT" in /tmp/gopnik-stage2.*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac && test -d "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT" && rm -rf -- "$GOPNIK_STAGE2_ROOT" && rm -f -- .git/gopnik-stage2-root
verification.notes: Stage 2 authenticates nothing. It used to run the setup and gate conversations live, which needed a credential, and it took the operator's: it symlinked ~/.claude/.credentials.json into two CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR trees and called that isolation. A live run refreshed the token, an OAuth refresh token is single-use, and every session on that credential was logged out mid-work. A shared credential is not isolated by the directory around it, and a verification step that can do that to the person running it is worse than the coverage it buys. What remains needs no login at all, and crosses the real boundary: the plugin loader resolves the marketplace and installs all three skills into an isolated host config that is asserted empty before and credential-free after; the raw installer runs from a clone pinned to the exact pushed revision, so an unpushed fix fails before anything else, and it preserves a file the project already owned; the fixture pack is exercised by its own test from the delivered clone rather than the working tree, with the executable bits a live procedure would need. What this deliberately does not prove: that a real agent session behaves as the skills say. That is the one thing no static check can reach, and it is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md as a procedure an operator runs deliberately, with a credential issued for verification and never their working login. A verdict that has not run it says so.
